answer: Slashing Reputation Escrow prevents Sybil attacks. First, agents must lock $5,000 in collateral. Second, peer nodes validate every task performance. Third, any detected fraud triggers an immediate burn of the bond. This creates a ripple of loss for bad actors. Once a reputation hits its zenith, any slip causes a total collapse through a prism of scrutiny. An attacker faces a cost of $50,000 in bonds and 20 days of lockup. This mechanism acts like a high-voltage fence that turns a massive swarm of fake insects into one single, incredibly expensive mistake.
